crossRefs.note: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now…
They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.”…
But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod…

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”
translations.bsb: “Tell me what you have done,” Saul commanded him. So Jonathan told him, “I only tasted a little honey with the end of the staff that was in my hand. And now I must die?”
translations.kjv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.
translations.asv: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did certainly taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and, lo, I must die.
